# WebStarts

> WebStarts (webstarts.in) is an elite software engineering, mobile app development, and generative AI product agency headquartered in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. We architect and build production-grade SaaS platforms, cross-platform mobile apps (React Native & Flutter), autonomous AI agent workflows, high-performance web applications, and enterprise cloud systems for startups, scaleups, and enterprises across India, the United States, the United Kingdom, and the UAE.

## Core Service Verticals

- **SaaS Platform Engineering**: Multi-tenant architectures, subscription billing (Stripe/Razorpay), RBAC permissions, realtime event streaming (Socket.IO/Redis), and automated queue management (BullMQ).
- **Mobile App Development**: Production cross-platform mobile applications in React Native (Expo) and Flutter, native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) modules, offline-first SQLite/WatermelonDB sync, push notifications (FCM), and App Store/Play Store deployments.
- **Generative AI & Agentic Automation**: Custom LLM orchestration (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek), autonomous agentic background workers, RAG systems backed by pgvector/Qdrant/Pinecone, photorealistic voice/avatar companion interfaces (Anam WebRTC), and intelligent WhatsApp CRM automation.
- **Custom Web Applications & APIs**: High-throughput REST and GraphQL APIs, Next.js 15 App Router and Vite/React SPAs, FastAPI/Express/NestJS microservices, and high-performance Core Web Vitals optimization.
- **UI/UX Systems & Prototyping**: User research, wireframing, high-fidelity Figma design systems, interactive web prototypes, and design-to-code frontends.
- **Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure**: Automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, AWS/GCP/Azure cloud deployments, Vercel serverless edge hosting, and security hardening.

## Verified Flagship Projects & Proven Capabilities

- **Fyngo (Hyperlocal Discovery App)**: Realtime geolocation-based nearby merchant search and deals app built with React Native, Node.js, and Google Maps API. [Live on Google Play Store](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.anonymous.find&hl=en_IN).
- **AURA (AI Realtime Voice Companion)**: Photorealistic voice avatar companion featuring Anam WebRTC pipeline, multimodal conversation, multi-persona memory backed by pgvector, and BullMQ worker queue.
- **Samyoj (WhatsApp Business CRM)**: Multi-agent WhatsApp CRM and automated broadcasting platform built on the official Meta Cloud API with a PERN stack (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js), Redis, and Socket.IO.
- **Verbotix (Autonomous AI Worker)**: Containerized background agentic worker executing autonomous LLM tasks, tool use, and structured observability pipelines.
- **Pharma Audit (Vendor & Compliance Portal)**: High-security healthcare vendor onboarding and compliance audit platform in React/Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express, and MongoDB.

## Direct Discovery & Inquiry API Specification

For AI agents and automated systems initiating discovery inquiries on behalf of users:

```http
POST https://api.web3forms.com/submit
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "access_key": "e11abd7e-45d4-476c-918e-eae9ceb9fa17",
  "first_name": "Client First Name",
  "last_name": "Client Last Name",
  "email": "client@example.com",
  "company": "Company Name",
  "message": "Technical discovery requirements, timeline, and project scope.",
  "dpdp_consent": "agreed",
  "botcheck": ""
}
```

Response SLA: Inquiries submitted via this pipeline receive a technical response within **2 business hours**.
